description: List activities for a lead — calls, emails, notes, SMS, meetings, and status changes. Returns a `data` array (with id, _type, type, date_created, and type-specific fields) plus `has_more` / `total_results`. Requires `lead_id`. Page with `_limit` / `_skip` to walk a lead's timeline.

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

lead_id.description: Lead ID whose activity timeline to fetch

title: Close List Activities
